findings.summary: Delegated implementation permits dirty or staged production changes to be absorbed into the trusted certification commit without task provenance.
Prior attempt artifacts are mutable, and deleting then re-adding remediation.json can move the review baseline forward and omit remediation commits.
Hook and history verification accept fabricated schema-valid review or validation failure evidence without proving the failed gate.
Remediated human approval instructs the approver to inspect the attempt-zero phase path instead of the active attempt-scoped artifact.
